note: Same genetic algorithm as ogolem/lj38. The archive is website/globalopt/lj75/lj75_clusters.tgz, 200 coords files. Success is the Cambridge N=75 minimum -397.492331 plus energy_above_minimum 0.001. The force cap is the problem max_force_calls, 1000000. The generation budget stays 19900. A start that exhausts the force cap is cap. A start that ends under the cap above the window is wrong_stationary.
